headline: Hawai'i Hilo alone unbeaten in a losing conference
dek: Hawai'i Hilo have won all three of their matches and conceded a single goal, with both of their meetings with fellow members among the wins. No other programme has won as often, and every other side in the conference has already lost at least once.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Concordia Irvine's nine goals have come from eight different scorers, a spread matched only by Dominican (Calif.), though they have conceded six in reaching the top of the chart.

wire.line: Concordia Irvine have scored nine goals, more than Biola, Chaminade, Jessup and Vanguard together.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Twelve matches dated in August still carry no published result, Dominican (Calif.)'s date at Menlo among them; the Dominican matches that do have a score have ended in three draws and one defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Chaminade have lost all three of their matches, scoring once and conceding six; the visit of UT Dallas was the third defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hawai'i Pacific's six goals have come from six different scorers, yet they have conceded seven and lost two of their three matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Robert Ronco has scored both of Vanguard's two goals, from ten shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Aidan Strickler has made nineteen saves for Westmont at a save percentage of .760.

last_match.line: UT Dallas lost only at Hawai'i Hilo on their tour of the islands; Chaminade have still not scored at home.

next_match.line: Every Hawai'i Hilo result so far has come at home or against a fellow member.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
